node.title: XR deficient-window payment: rational error directions leave only a forced-common-root kernel
node.statement: For the left syzygy space K_d of a deficient stacked high-window matrix, let G_d be the evaluation points at which both components of every syzygy vanish. Vandermonde inversion makes every syzygy a pointwise rational error-direction law for every maximal depth-d pair. At q>n there is a syzygy whose common H-root set is exactly G_d, all syzygies are divisible by its locator, dim K_d<=2(d-|G_d|), and rank J_d>=2|G_d|. If |G_d|<2(h-d), every counted pair has a selected ray in one fixed rational image of at most n slopes; high-depth ray injectivity gives N_d<=n<17n^2/25. Hence only full joint rank or a deficient kernel with at least 2(h-d) forced common roots remains.
